about: Voice identities and lines for GTA Melbourne. tools/voices/generate.py turns each line into an MP3 (Orpheus Australian-English TTS, offline) and writes its file, duration and check result back here; melbourne3d/js/voice-manager.js plays them. Paths are relative to /assets/audio/.

generator.model: ablmontazer/orpheus-australian-en-tts (Apache-2.0), run as mradermacher/orpheus-australian-en-tts-GGUF Q4_K_M with llama.cpp; SNAC 24 kHz decoder (hubertsiuzdak/snac_24khz, MIT)
generator.format: mp3, 24 kHz mono, 64 kb/s, loudness-normalised to -18 LUFS
